title: A data-centric machine learning approach to improve prediction of glioma grades using low-imbalance TCGA data
summary: Machine-learning classifiers applied to TCGA glioma data predicted tumor grade from molecular labels; the study did not establish external clinical validation.
organization: Fundación Estatal, Salud, Infancia y Bienestar Social, 28029, Madrid, Spain

evidence.tested: Machine-learning classifiers applied to TCGA glioma data predicted tumor grade from molecular labels; the study did not establish external clinical validation.
evidence.unknown: The reported classification used TCGA glioma-grade labels; performance in other datasets, prospective clinical utility, and patient outcomes were not established.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
